implementationSummary: Added analytics_kpi_cache package with Redis read-through get (analytics:kpi_envelope:{shop_id}), fail-open refresh after Postgres upsert, and optional create_redis_client factory. Wired precompute_shop_analytics_kpis to refresh Redis after successful AnalyticsKpiEnvelopesRepo.upsert. Four vertical-slice unit tests cover cache hit, miss fill, precompute refresh, and Redis outage degraded Postgres read. Postgres remains SoT; Redis never required for durability.

Optional redis_client injection at call sites; REDIS_URL factory for runtime wiring deferred to #531 Demo GET

risks: Cache hit reconstructs AnalyticsKpiEnvelope without DB id — acceptable for read path until #531 wires full envelope

Sync callers of precompute without redis_client skip cache refresh silently
